title: Surreal Mouse and Eye
description: A woman in a purple dress sits on a blue chaise lounge holding a lit candle, gazing at a large brown mouse standing on a yellow lily pad. The scene is set in a teal room with an arched window showing a frozen landscape at sunset, dominated by a giant stylized eye on the wall containing another mouse and starry patterns.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene inside a teal room with mystical symbols, a woman in a flowing purple off-shoulder dress sits barefoot on an ornate blue chaise lounge holding a lit red candle, looking toward a large realistic brown mouse standing upright on a giant yellow lily pad. An arched window reveals a frozen icy landscape with a river and setting sun. A massive stylized purple eye with intricate patterns covers the wall, its pupil containing a smaller mouse and cosmic starry swirls, floating pink orbs and decorative flourishes fill the air, detailed digital painting.
